what: a sea hag: a gaunt, stooped old woman of the cold deep sea who looks long drowned, painted seriously like a figure from an old saga, never a storybook witch. She has a long bony face with sunken cheeks, a wide thin mouth of small needle teeth and two large round bulging pale fish eyes. Her skin is clammy and pale like a fish's belly, faintly scaled, on the face, neck, arms and hands alike. She has no hair: in its place long, flat, broad ribbons of wet kelp grow from her scalp and hang to her knees, each ribbon as wide as her hand, dark green-black and glossy, with crinkled edges, plainly seaweed and not hair. Her hands are broad as paddles: sheets of pale grey skin join her long fingers together right to their tips, like the fin of a fish, and each finger ends in a hooked black nail. A few grey barnacles crust her shoulders. She has the realistic proportions of a thin adult woman with a small head and long limbs.
colours: pale fish-belly grey-white skin with grey-teal mottling, broad ribbons of dark green-black kelp in place of hair, pale yellow bulging eyes, a dull grey-brown dress of old sailcloth and dark brown fishing net, grey barnacles, black nails.
wears: She wears a long ragged dress of old grey-brown sailcloth that covers her from the neck to the ankles, with a torn dark fishing net draped over her shoulders like a shawl; her feet are bare. No hat, no jewellery.
holds: Her hands are empty: two broad webbed clawed hands, spread open, holding nothing. She has no staff.
pose: On two legs, she wades forward stooped, with one bare foot ahead of the other and her weight on the front foot, both arms raised in front of her with the broad webbed hands spread wide open, palms to the viewer, one high and one low, so the sheets of skin between the fingers are plainly seen; her head is thrust forward and her bulging eyes stare straight at the viewer, the kelp ribbons swinging.
must_show: a gaunt old woman with pale fish-belly skin, face and hands alike
large bulging pale fish eyes
broad flat ribbons of dark green-black kelp in place of hair, to her knees
a ragged sailcloth dress and a fishing-net shawl, fully clothed
empty webbed hands spread open: skin between the fingers plainly seen

what: a green hag: Jenny Greenteeth, the old woman who waits under the pond weed to drown children, painted seriously, never a storybook witch. She is a thin, hunched old woman with a long hooked nose, a pointed chin, a wide open snarling mouth full of long sharp crooked green-stained fangs and small sunken yellow eyes. Her skin is dull moss-green on the face, neck, arms and hands alike, wrinkled and warty. Her hair is long, lank and dark weed-green, hanging in wet strings. Her two arms are far too long for her body, thin and sinewy, reaching below her knees, with long knotted fingers and dirty brown nails. She has the realistic proportions of a thin adult woman with a small head.
colours: dull moss-green skin, dark weed-green stringy hair, small yellow eyes, green-stained teeth, a ragged dark mud-brown wool dress the colour of wet peat, a dull grey shawl, brown nails.
wears: She wears a ragged long-sleeved dark mud-brown wool peasant dress, the colour of wet peat, that covers her from the neck to the ankles, and a dull grey knitted shawl knotted at her chest; her feet are bare. No hat.
holds: Her hands are empty: two long-fingered grasping hands holding nothing. She has no staff.
pose: On two legs, she creeps forward bent low at the waist, one foot ahead of the other with her weight on the front foot, both of her over-long arms stretched far out ahead of her with the fingers hooked to grab, her head tipped up, her fanged mouth open.
must_show: a hunched old woman with dull moss-green skin, face and hands alike
arms far too long, both reaching out to grab
lank dark green hair in strings
a grin of long sharp teeth
a ragged brown dress and shawl, fully clothed

what: an annis hag: Black Annis of the Dane Hills, a monster and not a human woman, a towering, hunchbacked, heavy-boned ogress far bigger and stronger than any other hag, with long thick arms that reach to her knees and enormous hands. Her skin is not the colour of any living person: it is cold dull stone-blue, the blue-grey of wet slate, hard and rough like weathered rock, with paler blue-grey on the cheekbones, brow and knuckles and blue-black in the hollows, the same on her face, neck and hands. Her face is a monster's: a long hooked nose, a jutting warty chin, deep cracks for wrinkles, heavy brows, and two round eyes that glow pale yellow-white like lamps with no pupils. Her mouth is stretched wide open in a snarl and is full of iron teeth: two rows of long, pointed, dark grey metal spikes. A wild matted mane of coarse black and iron-grey hair stands out from her head in every direction and hangs in knotted ropes to her shoulders. Each of her fingers ends in one long, thick, curved claw of grey iron, as long as the finger itself, with a bright steel glint along its edge. She has the proportions of a very tall, strongly built giantess with a small head.
colours: cold dull stone-blue skin, the blue-grey of wet slate, on face, neck and hands; matted black and iron-grey hair; pale yellow-white glowing eyes; dark grey iron teeth; grey iron claws with bright steel glints; a ragged black dress with dark grey tattered edges; a frayed grey rope belt hung with three small ivory-white sheep skulls.
wears: She wears a ragged black long-sleeved dress of coarse wool that covers her whole body from the neck to the ankles, the sleeves reaching her wrists, the hem and cuffs in dark grey tatters, belted with a frayed rope from which hang three small white sheep skulls. Her head is bare and she wears no fur and no cloak.
holds: Her hands are empty: both hands are open with the long iron claws spread wide, holding nothing. She has no staff.
pose: On two legs, she lunges forward to the left, hunched, with her knees bent and her weight on her front foot, her right arm raised high with the iron claws spread to rake downward, her left arm reaching out low in front to snatch, her head thrust forward, glowing eyes fixed on the viewer, iron teeth bared in a snarl.
must_show: a monster hag, plainly not a living woman: cold stone-blue skin on face and hands alike
glowing pale lamp eyes and a snarling mouth of dark iron teeth
long grey iron claws on every finger, readable in the small sprite
a wild matted mane of black and grey hair
a towering hunched powerful build, fully clothed in a ragged black dress with a rope belt of small skulls

what: a night hag: the mare of the old Germanic tales, who sits on a sleeper's chest at night, the most dreadful and commanding of the hags. She is a tall, lean, upright old woman with skin as black as charcoal on the face, neck, arms and hands alike. She has a long gaunt face with high cheekbones and a thin cruel mouth, two small burning ember eyes, and two short ridged horns curling back from her brow. Her hair is long, straight and bone-white, falling past her waist. Her fingers are very long and thin with long black nails. She has the realistic proportions of a tall adult woman, about eight heads tall, with a small head.
colours: charcoal-black skin, long bone-white hair, small ember-red eyes, dark grey horns, a black gown with dark grey ragged edges, a dull silver crescent-moon pendant on a silver chain.
wears: She wears a long black high-necked gown with long trailing ragged sleeves that covers her from the neck to the ground, and one dull silver crescent-moon pendant on a chain on her chest. No hood, bare head.
holds: Her hands are empty: two long thin black hands with long nails, holding nothing. She has no staff.
pose: On two legs, she glides forward in a long stride with her weight on her front foot and her body leaning forward, her right arm stretched straight out ahead with the long fingers reaching to touch, her left hand lifted beside her head with the fingers curled, her chin lowered and her ember eyes fixed on the viewer, her white hair and ragged sleeves streaming behind.
must_show: a tall lean old woman with charcoal-black skin, face and hands alike
long bone-white hair
two short horns on her brow and small ember-red eyes
a long black gown, fully clothed, with a silver crescent pendant
one long-fingered hand reaching out, both hands empty

what: a hobgoblin warlord: a very tall, massively broad, battle-scarred goblinoid war chief, upright like a man, with dark forest-green skin, a flat fierce face, short pointed ears, a heavy jaw with two small tusks and a roaring open mouth. He has the realistic proportions of a big heavy adult warrior with a small head.
colours: dark forest-green skin, blackened iron plate armour, dull red cloth, a short dull red horsehair crest, pale ivory bone and tooth trophies, a dark wooden axe haft and a grey steel axe head.
wears: He wears heavy blackened iron plate armour on his chest, shoulders, arms and legs over a dull red tabard, and an open-faced iron helmet with a short red horsehair crest. Trophies hang on the plates: a string of big ivory teeth across the breastplate and one small pale skull fixed on the left shoulder plate. No cape.
holds: He holds exactly one great axe in both hands: a long thick dark wooden haft as tall as his chest with one broad, heavy, single-bladed steel axe head at the top. Both of his hands grip the haft. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he strides forward with his weight on his front foot and his body twisted, the great axe swung up and back over his right shoulder in both hands ready to chop, his head thrust forward and his mouth wide open in a war cry.
must_show: a big dark-green hobgoblin in blackened plate armour and a crested helmet
one great axe gripped in both hands
tooth and skull trophies on the armour
mouth open in a war cry
heavier and more armoured than a plain hobgoblin soldier

what: a hobgoblin marshal: the supreme commander of a hobgoblin legion, a tall, straight-backed, broad-shouldered goblinoid officer, upright like a man, with dark forest-green skin, a stern flat face, short pointed ears, two small tusks and a grey scar across one cheek. He carries himself like a Roman general. He has the realistic proportions of a tall adult warrior, about eight heads tall, with a small head.
colours: dark forest-green skin, polished black steel plate armour with bright gold trim, a tall dull red horsehair crest, a long dark red cape, a bright steel sword with a gold hilt, a gold eagle-skull badge.
wears: He wears a full suit of polished black steel plate armour edged everywhere with bright gold trim, with a gold badge on the breastplate, a long dark red cape hanging from both shoulders to his ankles, and a black steel helmet with gold cheek plates and one tall red horsehair crest that runs across the helmet from ear to ear like a Roman centurion's.
holds: He holds exactly one straight longsword in his right hand, a broad bright steel blade with a gold crossguard, held low and ready. His left hand is empty: the left arm is stretched straight out with the first finger pointing forward, giving an order. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he steps forward with his weight on his front foot and his chest square, his left arm thrown straight out pointing ahead in command and his sword held ready at his right side, his mouth open bellowing an order, his cape swinging behind him.
must_show: a dark-green hobgoblin officer in black plate armour with gold trim
a tall red crest running sideways across the helmet
a long dark red cape
one straight longsword in the right hand
the empty left hand pointing forward in command
plainly higher in rank than the warlord: gold, cape and crest

what: an imp: a very small, lean, wiry devil from a medieval church carving, painted seriously, sinewy and sly, never cute. It has a narrow, sharp-chinned, wrinkled face with a hooked nose, slanted yellow eyes, long pointed ears, a thin smirking mouth of small sharp teeth and two short stubby horns. It has thin arms and legs with clawed hands and clawed feet, and two small leathery bat wings. It has exactly one tail: a long, thick tail of fat round segments, one after another, that ends in a swollen black bulb as big as its fist with one big curved black needle-point hooking out of it: a scorpion's sting. Its skin is dull brick-red on the face, body, arms, legs and tail alike. It has a small head and a lean body, like a starved monkey's.
colours: dull brick-red skin, darker red-brown wing membranes, short black horns, a black scorpion sting, yellow eyes, a ragged dark brown loincloth.
wears: It wears only a ragged dark brown loincloth.
holds: Its hands are empty: two small clawed hands holding nothing.
pose: It flies in empty air with both bat wings spread open above it and its feet off the ground, its knees drawn up, its body leaning forward to the left, both clawed hands reaching out ahead. Its one tail curves up behind its back and forward over the top of its head, and the swollen black sting hangs in front of its brow, pointing forward to strike.
must_show: a small lean brick-red devil with short stubby horns
two small bat wings spread
a scorpion's tail with a big black sting, arched over the head
a sly wrinkled painted face, not a cute one
empty clawed hands

what: a demonic imp: a small, lean, hard-muscled courier devil of an infernal house, older and far crueller than a common imp, painted seriously, never cute. It has a narrow gaunt face with a jutting chin, slanted burning yellow eyes, long pointed ears, a mouth of long fangs and two long black horns that curve up and back from its brow. It has long thin arms with long sharp black talons on every finger, clawed feet, and two large ragged bat wings with torn edges. Its tail is long, thick and jointed like a scorpion's, and a small tongue of flame burns on the black sting at its tip. Its skin is deep dark wine-red, the colour of dried blood, on the face, body, arms, legs and tail alike, never brown; its wing membranes are black. It has a small head and a lean body.
colours: deep dark wine-red skin with black shadows, black wing membranes, long black horns, black talons, burning yellow eyes, a black leather satchel strap and kilt, one cream parchment scroll with a bright red wax seal, a small bright yellow flame on the tail sting.
wears: It wears a short black leather kilt and a black leather courier's strap across its chest with a small satchel at the hip.
holds: It holds exactly one rolled cream parchment scroll with a round red wax seal in its left hand, gripped in its fist and held up. Its right hand is empty, the long black talons spread wide. It holds nothing else.
pose: It flies in empty air with both ragged wings spread wide above it and its feet off the ground, its body leaning forward to the left, its right arm stretched out ahead with the talons spread to pinch, the scroll held up in its left fist, and its scorpion tail arched high over its head with the small flame burning on the sting.
must_show: a lean very dark crimson devil with long curved black horns
large ragged bat wings spread
a scorpion tail arched over the head with a small flame on the sting
one rolled parchment scroll with a red seal in the left hand
long black talons on the empty right hand
darker, longer-horned and better equipped than the common imp
must_not_show: ball of flame hiding the body

what: a hostile leprechaun: the fairy shoemaker of old Irish folklore in a foul temper, painted seriously like an Arthur Rackham fairy, never a cereal-box mascot. He is a short, stocky, weathered old man with the proportions of a small grown man, a normal-sized head, a deeply lined scowling face, a red bulb of a nose, small hard eyes under bushy brows and a thick bristling copper-red beard with no moustache gap. His teeth are bared in a snarl.
colours: weathered light tan skin, a copper-red beard, a faded deep emerald-green coat with dull brass buttons, a brown leather cobbler's apron, tan breeches, grey stockings, black shoes with dull brass buckles, a battered deep emerald-green hat with a black band, a dark brown-black club, one gold coin.
wears: He wears a faded deep emerald-green tail coat with brass buttons, a worn brown leather cobbler's apron over it, tan knee breeches, grey stockings, black buckled shoes, and a battered, dented tall-crowned hat of the same deep emerald-green cloth as his coat, with a black band and a brass buckle. The hat and the coat are the same green.
holds: He holds exactly one shillelagh in his right hand, raised high: a short, thick, knobbly dark blackthorn club with a heavy round knot at its end, as thick as his wrist. In his left hand he holds exactly one large gold coin, pinched between finger and thumb and held out in front of him. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he charges forward with his weight on his front foot and his body twisted, his right arm raised high and back with the club ready to bring down, his left hand thrust out ahead showing the gold coin, his chin down and his teeth bared.
must_show: a short stocky scowling old man with a copper-red beard
a faded emerald-green coat and a battered buckled hat of the same green
a cobbler's leather apron
one thick knobbly club raised in the right hand
one gold coin held out in the left hand
weathered and angry, not jolly

what: a charnel hound: the bare skeleton of a big lean hound on four legs, built by a necromancer from the bones of several dogs wired together. It is nothing but old bones with dark empty air between them, no fur, no flesh and no skin anywhere. It has a long dog's skull with big fangs and empty black eye sockets, a neck of thick vertebrae, a deep open cage of big ribs, a level spine with a row of extra jagged bone spurs standing up along it, four long bone legs and a long thin bone tail. Thick dark iron wire is wound round its joints, and one dark iron band is riveted round its ribcage.
colours: old yellowed ivory and brown-stained bone on every part, the skull included, black empty eye sockets, dark gunmetal-grey iron wire and band.
wears: It is a skeleton beast and wears nothing but the iron wire and band that hold it together.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it runs forward in a long stride with its front legs reaching ahead and its hind legs pushing off, its spine level, its skull thrust forward and low with the fanged jaws wide open to bite, its bone tail straight out behind.
must_show: a dog's skeleton on four legs, bare yellowed bone everywhere, skull included
an open ribcage with dark gaps between the ribs
dark iron wire and a band binding the bones
bone spurs along the spine
fanged jaws open

what: Hecate's hound: a ghostly black hound of the Greek underworld, a real dog on four legs, lean and long-legged like a big greyhound-mastiff, with a narrow head, upright pointed ears and a long thin tail. Its coat is short and pitch-black all over, and a ragged mane of black smoke streams back from its neck and along its spine like torn cloth, joined to the body. Its two eyes are small, round and blank moon-white with no pupils. Round its neck is a broad old bronze collar, and one large old bronze key hangs from the collar on a ring.
colours: pitch-black coat with dark charcoal-grey highlights, dark grey smoke along the back, small blank moon-white eyes, ivory fangs, a dull bronze collar and a dull bronze key.
wears: It wears one broad dull bronze collar with one large bronze key hanging from it.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: all four of its feet are on the ground with its front legs braced straight and its hindquarters lowered, its neck stretched up and its muzzle pointed to the sky with the jaws open, howling, the smoke mane streaming back to the right and its tail held low.
must_show: a lean pitch-black hound on four legs, howling with its muzzle raised
a ragged mane of dark smoke along the neck and back, joined to the body
blank white eyes
a bronze collar with a large key hanging from it
must_not_show: cloud of mist round the body

what: Fionn's hound: a giant Irish wolfhound of the old hero tales, a real living dog on four legs, very tall and long-legged with a deep chest, a tucked-up belly, a long narrow bearded muzzle, small folded ears and a long curved tail. Its coat is rough, shaggy and wiry all over, dark iron-grey like wet slate with charcoal-black along the back and a little paler ash-grey on the muzzle and legs. Its eyes are dark amber, steady and wise. Its lips are drawn back from long ivory fangs in a snarl. Round its neck it wears a thick twisted gold torc, an open Celtic neck ring with a round knob at each end.
colours: rough dark iron-grey and charcoal-black shaggy fur with ash-grey on the muzzle and legs, a warm neutral grey with no tan, no white and no sky tint, dark amber eyes, a black nose, ivory fangs, a bright gold torc.
wears: It wears one thick twisted gold torc round its neck; nothing else.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it bounds forward at a gallop with its front legs stretched out ahead and its hind legs driving behind, its long body level, its head held low and forward with the jaws open in a snarl showing its fangs and its eyes fixed ahead, its hackles raised, its tail streaming behind.
must_show: a tall, shaggy, rough-coated dark grey wolfhound on four legs, a living dog
a thick gold torc round the neck
bounding forward, snarling with fangs bared
a war hound, fierce, not a friendly pet

what: the Lernaean Hydra of the Greek myth: a great water serpent with many heads. Its body is one single thick snake's body lying in a heavy coil, and from the top of that coil a bundle of long snake necks rises and fans out like the fingers of an open hand, each neck ending in one snake's head with open jaws and long fangs. The necks are all joined to the one body. The heads are plain serpent heads, smooth and hornless. One of the necks ends in a blackened, seared stump with no head. The whole creature is covered in smooth wet scales.
colours: dark swamp-green scales on every neck and on the body, a pale yellow belly and throat on each neck, yellow eyes, ivory fangs, one charcoal-black seared stump.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side: the thick coil of its body sits at the lower right and the fan of necks rears up and leans to the left, the heads at different heights, the highest head striking forward to the left with its jaws stretched wide, the others hissing. It floats in empty air with nothing under it.
must_show: one coiled serpent body with many long snake necks fanning from it
a snake's head with open fanged jaws on each neck
dark swamp-green scales with pale yellow throats
plain hornless serpent heads
the necks readable as separate necks in the small sprite
must_not_show: snakes not joined to the body

what: a mythic hydra: an ancient, enormous many-headed dragon-beast, a four-legged reptile that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, with a massive barrel body, four thick clawed legs and one long heavy tail. From its shoulders five long, thick, armoured necks rise and fan out, all joined to the one body, and each neck ends in a dragon-like head with a crown of swept-back ivory horns, a spiny frill and open fanged jaws. A row of tall spines runs down every neck and along the back to the tail. Its scales are dark and heavy, and its chest and the undersides of its necks are armoured in broad bronze-gold plates.
colours: dark teal-black scales on the necks, body, legs and tail, bronze-gold chest and throat plates, ivory horns and spines, yellow eyes, ivory fangs, one short squirt of bright yellow acid.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its heavy body is horizontal. Its five necks rear up and fan out to the left at different heights, every head with its jaws open; the lowest head stretches straight forward and squirts one short thick spurt of bright yellow liquid from its mouth, joined to the mouth and no longer than its own head. Its heavy tail is swung up behind at the right.
must_show: a massive four-legged body with all four feet on the ground
several long armoured necks fanning from the shoulders, each with a horned dragon-like head
dark teal-black scales with bronze-gold throat and chest plates
tall spines down the necks and back
a short spurt of yellow acid from one mouth
plainly grander and more armoured than the Lernaean hydra

what: a clockwork horror: a brass machine built in the shape of a spider, old, scratched, dented and tarnished, a real working mechanism and never a toy. Its body is one rounded riveted brass shell like a fat pocket watch lying flat, with a round glass window in its top showing dark toothed cogwheels inside. Six thick jointed brass legs arch out from its sides, three on each side, and each leg ends in one flat round grey steel disc as big as a dinner plate, with a ring of pointed teeth all round its rim like a cogwheel: a circular saw blade, standing on edge like a wheel. At the front of the shell, in the place of a head, two short thick copper prongs stick out side by side like a tuning fork, and one small bright jagged yellow spark jumps between their tips.
colours: tarnished yellow-brown brass shell and legs with dark brown grime in the joints, grey steel saw blades, dull copper prongs, dark iron cogwheels, one small bright yellow spark.
wears: It is a machine and wears nothing.
holds: It is a machine with saw-tipped legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side and a little from above, facing left: it scuttles forward on its saw-tipped legs with the two front legs lifted high off the ground and reaching forward, their saw blades raised to cut, the copper prongs pointing ahead with the spark between them, its body tilted.
must_show: a spider-shaped machine of tarnished brass with jointed metal legs
a flat round toothed steel disc at the end of each leg
two copper prongs with a yellow spark in place of a head
cogwheels showing in the body
old, scratched and weathered metal

what: a hook horror: a tall, gaunt cave monster that walks upright on two thick legs, hunched forward. Its head is a vulture's: bald, wrinkled and grey, with a large, heavy, sharply hooked ivory beak and two small round black eyes, on a short thick neck. Its chest, belly, back, arms and legs are covered in thick, dark, ridged horny plates, banded across the chest and belly in segments, with a row of blunt spikes down its spine. Its two arms are long, and neither arm has a hand: from the elbow down, each arm is one single great curved blade of pale bone, shaped like a crescent moon, as long as its whole leg and tapering to a sharp point. The two pale bone crescents are the biggest and brightest things on it. Its feet are broad with three blunt claws.
colours: dark grey-brown and black chitin plates with dull tan edges, a wrinkled grey head, a yellowed ivory beak, two pale bone-ivory arm hooks, small black eyes.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It has no hands and no fingers and holds nothing: each arm ends at the elbow in one great curved crescent of pale bone that grows out of the arm.
pose: On two legs, seen from the side and facing left, it stomps forward hunched with its weight on its front foot, both arms swung out in front of its chest, one a little higher than the other, the two great pale bone crescents curving forward and down like a pair of sickle blades about to close on its prey, its beak open in a screech. Its bald head is smooth and round on top.
must_show: an upright hunched monster covered in dark ridged horny plates
each arm ending in one great curved pale bone hook, no hands
a bald vulture's head with a big hooked beak
two legs, no wings

what: an ossuary horror: a charnel house that has got up and moves, one great rolling heap of old human bones, taller than it is wide and leaning like a breaking wave. The heap is built of a few dozen large, clearly drawn bones with deep black gaps between them: big round skulls with black eye sockets set here and there over its surface, long thigh bones, ribs curving out like the staves of a broken barrel, and a pelvis or two. Nothing holds the bones but themselves. From the upper left of the heap one long thick lash reaches out: a chain of big spine bones, one after another, touching, ending in a single skull with open jaws.
colours: old yellowed ivory and brown-stained bone throughout, deep black gaps and black eye sockets, a few dull grey shadows.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The heap surges and topples toward the left like a wave about to break, piled highest at the right, its crest of skulls curling over to the left, and the long lash of spine bones whips out to the left at mid height with the skull at its tip snapping.
must_show: one leaning heap of large bones and skulls with dark gaps between them
several big skulls readable in the small sprite
one long lash of spine bones reaching out with a skull at its tip
yellowed old bone, not a pale blob
no single body: not one skeleton

what: a fungal horror: a great heaving mound of fungus that has grown over a dead adventurer and never stopped growing, painted seriously as rotting woodland growth, never a storybook mushroom. It is one tall lopsided heap of pale mould and fungus flesh, crusted all over with tiers of broad shelf fungi like the brackets on a dead tree, clusters of thin-stalked pale toadstools, and round puffballs that have burst open at the top. Its bottom edge is one plain rounded line like the bottom of a sack, with nothing spreading out from under it. Half sunk in the front of the mound are the remains it grew from: one dented steel helmet and a few ribs of a ribcage, with fungus growing through them. It has no face of any kind.
colours: pale bone-grey and sickly cream mould, dull ochre and rust-brown shelf fungi with pale tan edges, dark brown rot in the hollows, a dull grey steel helmet, ivory ribs, one small puff of dull ochre-yellow spores.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The mound heaves and leans to the left, piled highest at the right, one thick blunt arm of fungus-crusted growth reaching out to the left at mid height, and from a burst puffball at its top one small tight puff of ochre-yellow spores shoots up and to the left, joined to the puffball.
must_show: a lopsided mound of mould crusted with shelf fungi and toadstools
a dented helmet and ribs half sunk in it
a small puff of ochre spores joined to the top
no face at all
rotting, weathered painted growth, not a cute mushroom
must_not_show: cloud of spores round the body
tangle of roots at the base

what: a vine horror: a hanging knot of dry, dead-looking creeper that strangles whatever walks beneath it. It is one dense tangled ball of thick, woody, twisted vines, each vine as thick as a man's arm and studded with large dark hooked thorns, wound over and under one another with dark gaps between them. A few dry curled dead leaves cling to it. From the underside of the knot several long thick thorned tendrils hang down and lash outward at different lengths, their tips curled like hooks. Caught fast in the middle of the knot, wrapped round by vines, is one pale human skull. It has no face of its own.
colours: dry grey-brown and dark umber woody vines with pale tan highlights, large black-brown thorns, a few dull rust-brown dead leaves, one pale ivory skull, dark gaps.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: It hangs in empty air with nothing under it, its knot at the upper right, and its tendrils drop and whip down and to the left: the longest tendril lashes far out to the lower left with its hooked tip curling, a second coils into a tightening loop, the rest swing beside them.
must_show: a hanging tangled knot of thick dry woody vines
large dark thorns on the vines
long thorned tendrils lashing down and outward
one skull caught in the tangle
dry and brown, dead-looking, no green

what: a lurking horror: a great mimic, a monster in the exact shape of a large, rich, iron-bound treasure coffer, caught at the moment it stops pretending. It is one big old chest of dark oak planks with a rounded lid, heavy black iron bands, iron corner plates and a big brass lock plate on the front. The lid is thrown wide open like an upper jaw, and the chest is a mouth: along the whole rim of the lid and the whole rim of the box runs a row of long, sharp, crooked ivory fangs, and the inside is wet dark red flesh. One long, thick, dark red tongue lolls out over the front. From one side of the chest a thick ropy arm of the same dark wood-brown flesh has pushed out and reaches forward, dripping yellow acid. The wood is scarred and weathered. It has no eyes.
colours: dark oak-brown planks, black iron bands and corner plates, a tarnished brass lock plate, long ivory fangs, a wet dark red mouth and tongue, a wood-brown fleshy arm, drops of bright yellow acid.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side: the chest lunges up and to the left, tilted, its fanged lid gaping wide open, the tongue lashing out to the left, and the thick fleshy arm stretching out to the left beside it with acid dripping from its tip. It has nothing under it.
must_show: an iron-bound wooden treasure chest that is a monster
the open lid and the box rim lined with long ivory fangs
a wet dark red mouth inside and a long tongue
one fleshy arm pushing out of the side
weathered painted wood and iron, not a cartoon chest

what: an astral horror: a thing from outside the world that came in through a dream, painted with depth and weight like a storm at night, never a flat shape. It is one tall ragged tear of living night sky, a boiling mass of pitch-black vapour with torn, fraying edges, and inside the blackness are deep swirls of dark blue and teal star-cloud scattered with tiny white stars. Set into the mass at different heights and different sizes are many narrow, slanted, lidless eyes, each a thin pale silver slit with no pupil, all turned the same way. From its edges several long, thin, tapering ribbons of the same starry blackness reach outward like groping fingers of thought, their edges catching a cold pale light.
colours: pitch-black vapour, deep midnight-blue and dark teal star-cloud swirls inside it, tiny white star points, narrow pale silver-white slit eyes, cold pale blue-white light along the torn edges.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: It hangs in empty air and surges toward the left, its mass leaning and boiling, taller at the right, its long ribbons of darkness reaching out to the left at different heights, the longest stretching far forward and curling at its tip, every slit eye turned to the left.
must_show: a ragged, torn, boiling mass of black with stars and blue-teal cloud inside it
many narrow silver slit eyes of different sizes set in the mass
long tapering ribbons of darkness reaching out
painted depth and lit torn edges, not a flat blob
no fixed body shape

what: the Iron Patriarch: an ancient tyrant king sealed for centuries inside the suit of plate armour he was crowned in, a tall, massive, heavy-set armoured figure who stands like an iron statue come to life. No skin, no face and no hair show anywhere: every part of him is cased in thick, old, dark gunmetal-grey iron plate, nearly black, pitted, with a few streaks of brown rust and tarnished gold bands at the edges of the plates. His head is entirely enclosed in a great helm: a flat-topped iron bucket helm that covers the whole head and neck, its front a blank iron face plate with one narrow black cross-shaped eye slit and a few small breathing holes. A heavy crown with tall square points is forged onto the top of the helm as one piece with it. He has the realistic proportions of a big adult man, about eight heads tall, with a small head.
colours: dark gunmetal-grey iron plate armour, nearly black, with brown rust streaks and tarnished gold edge bands, a dark iron crown with tarnished gold points, a long ragged dark royal-purple mantle with a dull grey fur collar, a dark iron warhammer.
wears: He wears a full suit of heavy dark iron plate armour from head to foot with a crowned, fully closed great helm, and a long, faded, moth-eaten dark royal-purple mantle with a dull grey fur collar hanging from his shoulders down his back to his heels.
holds: He holds exactly one warhammer in his right hand, raised: a thick iron haft as long as his arm with one massive square block of iron for a head, flat on one face and with a short spike on the other. His left hand is empty: a huge iron gauntlet, open, swept out in front of him with the fingers spread. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he strides forward heavily with his weight on his front foot and his body twisted, his right arm raised high and back with the warhammer ready to fall, his left gauntlet sweeping out in front of him, his crowned helm lowered, his mantle swinging.
must_show: a massive figure sealed in dark grey iron plate with tarnished gold bands
a fully closed great helm with a crown forged onto it, no face showing
a ragged dark purple royal mantle with a fur collar
one big square-headed warhammer raised in the right hand
an empty iron gauntlet sweeping out
the most ornate and imposing figure of the group: a boss

what: an iron sentinel: a vault guardian built by dwarven smiths a thousand years ago, a machine in the rough shape of a very broad, thick-limbed armoured warrior, far wider at the shoulders than at the hips, with a barrel chest, short thick legs and long heavy arms that end in huge iron fists like anvils. It is made of thick, curved, hand-forged plates of dark iron joined with rows of big round rivets, weathered, pitted, scratched and dented, never smooth and never square. The iron is black-grey like an old anvil, with cold pale steel-grey on every worn edge. Its head is a low riveted iron dome sunk between the shoulders like a dwarf's helmet, with one narrow horizontal slit across the front glowing dull amber, and an iron grille below it shaped like a braided beard. In the middle of its chest a round opening shows a cluster of big brass cogwheels meshed together. Bands of angular dwarven runes are cut round its wrists and across its brow.
colours: black and dark gunmetal-grey iron plates on every part with cold steel-grey worn edges and black joints, bright yellow brass cogwheels in the chest, one dull amber-yellow eye slit, pale grey rune cuts. The iron is black-grey.
wears: It is a machine of iron plates and wears nothing over them.
holds: Its hands are empty: two huge clenched iron fists holding nothing.
pose: On two legs, it stamps forward with its weight on its front foot and its body twisted, its right fist drawn far back at shoulder height to punch and its left fist held out low in front as a guard, its domed head lowered.
must_show: a broad, heavy machine-warrior of dark grey riveted iron plates: grey-black, not brown
brass cogwheels showing in a round opening in the chest
a low domed head with one glowing amber slit and a beard-shaped grille
two huge iron fists, empty
hand-forged and weathered, not a toy and not a modern robot

what: an iron horseman: a rider of the end of the world, a horse and its rider that have grown together into one single statue of black iron that moves. The horse is not a living animal: it is a horse shape built of thick black iron plates riveted and welded together, on four heavy iron legs, with no hide and no hair anywhere; its head is a blank spiked iron face plate, its mane is a row of tall black iron spikes down the neck, and its tail is a bundle of hanging black iron chains. The rider is a knight of the same black iron, sitting upright, his legs sunk into the horse's flanks and welded there with no gap and no saddle, his head a closed iron helm with one narrow slit and a crest of tall iron spikes. Pale grey weld seams run all over both of them. A dull furnace-orange light glows in the helm slit, in the horse's two eye slits and in the horse's nostrils.
colours: black and dark gunmetal-grey iron on the horse and the rider alike, pale grey weld seams and rivets, small dull furnace-orange glows in the eye slits and nostrils, a pale steel-grey lance.
wears: Horse and rider are one welded shell of black iron plate and wear nothing over it: no cloak, no cloth, no leather.
holds: The rider holds exactly one jousting lance, couched under his right arm: a long, very thick, straight pole of pale steel-grey iron, as thick as his arm, tapering to a point. The lance lies flat and horizontal like the horizon, and its point sticks out far in front of the horse's nose, at the left of the picture. His left hand is an iron gauntlet resting on the horse's neck, fused to it, holding nothing.
pose: Seen in full profile from the side like a figure on a coin, facing left: the iron horse gallops forward on four legs, its two front legs reaching ahead and its two hind legs driving off behind, its head lowered and its spiked neck arched; the rider leans forward over the horse's neck with the lance levelled, horizontal, pointing straight to the left, its point reaching past the horse's nose into the empty backdrop at the left.
must_show: one iron horse on four legs with one iron rider, both black iron plate
the horse plainly made of metal: spiked iron mane, chain tail, no hair
rider and horse fused together
one thick pale lance, horizontal, its point ahead of the horse's nose
small furnace-orange glows in the eye slits
a spiked crest on the rider's helm
must_not_show: man's torso on a horse's body
lance cut off by the edge of the picture
